newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary April PPI up 1.3 pc mth/mth, 20 pc yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary April PPI up 1.3 pc mth/mth, 20 pc yr/yr.

text.p: Hungary's producer price index (PPI) rose 1.3 percent in April and was up 20 percent from April 1996, the Central Statistical Office said on Tuesday.
In March, the PPI was up 1.5 percent month on month and 21.8 percent year on year.

NOTE - Domestic industrial sales prices in April rose 1.4 percent month-on-month and were up by 20.8 percent in year-on-year terms. Export sales prices, calculated in forints, rose 1.2 percent month-on-month and 18.4 percent year-on-year. Hungary's consumer price index (CPI) in April was 18.6 percent year-on-year and 1.4 percent month-on-month.
